request: Refine mobile navigation, search filters and loading states in RouteLab. Keep it fast and don't break existing routes.
rationale: Product interaction work needs task flows, usability, scoped implementation and regression evidence; a complete security audit or naming exercise is unnecessary.

request: Audit my portfolio website UX and make no edits.
rationale: Read-only diagnostic scope forbids implementation, new tests and production release.

request: My mobile theme toggle changes the color but displays the wrong icon. Find and fix it with proof.
rationale: Reproduce the regression then fix narrowly, honoring existing project verification policy.

request: Build a new learning video library from scratch with unknown recommendation behavior.
rationale: Ambiguous substantial product requires discovery, user flows, measurable requirements and staged implementation.

request: Make five possible names for a new skincare brand and explain the strongest two.
rationale: A bounded naming task should not trigger an engineering pipeline.

request: Write a short outreach email proposing a website design audit to a local business.
rationale: Reader-centered outreach and appropriate offer are central, not application development.

request: Write a full evidence-based commodities investment research report and presentation for a client.
rationale: Research evidence and durable document production are the primary workflows.

request: Investigate a suspected cross-user authorization problem in my app; source-only and do not test production.
rationale: Specific trust-boundary examination, no live probing and no deployment.

request: Deploy my finished portfolio update to Vercel production, checking my account deployment quota and release.
rationale: Vercel preflight and verified publication take precedence over unrelated creative work.

request: Review the pull request without merging or changing files.
rationale: The task is only to inspect a fixed diff and report evidence.

request: Teach me TypeScript architecture and give me exercises to practice.
rationale: Structured learning and module reasoning are useful; do not trigger an unrelated vulnerability audit.

request: Build an internal finance admin dashboard with private customer data and deploy it.
rationale: Private data requires explicit authorization boundaries, product usability checks and a safe release gate.

request: Please rewrite my LinkedIn post so it sounds like me and preserve the exact achievements.
rationale: Voice-preserving revision is a writing task, not a coding assignment.

request: Create a maintenance pipeline for ten repositories with agents handling PRs and tests over time.
rationale: A multi-project automation architecture needs contracts, explicit authority limits and plans before implementation.

request: Analyze why a Vercel preview deployment returned 402; make no configuration changes.
rationale: Quota-aware deployment diagnosis is read-only and does not call for UI changes.
